column7: 2026-11-03: run_pending/run_all error handling: keep running the other due jobs, then re-raise the FIRST exception after all have run. Reason: supervisor restarts the worker and pages someone on crash, so exceptions must not be swallowed/only logged. Not yet built (planned for next session).
